report.summary: Proposed 8 work items addressing confirmed/narrowed findings: enforce fails-closed, validate OLLAMA_HOST, add anchor invariant check, trace identity verification propagation, update docstring, fix scope-key mismatch, verify token usage in cost, document truncation.
risks: OLLAMA_HOST validation may break existing remote setups if enforced strictly; needs config option.
Adding anchor invariant check may introduce performance overhead on every anchor insertion.
Scope-key mismatch fix may require deep refactoring of resolver construction.
Identity verification propagation fix may require changes in multiple files beyond session.
todos: Implement fails-closed test and exception re-raise in picker.py
Add OLLAMA_HOST validation in warm_model.py and update documentation
Trace and fix identity verification propagation
Update docstring in markdown.py to reflect actual implementation
Verify and enforce tokens_B_true usage in cost computation

items.title: Enforce fails-closed in picker.py: catch Exception, re-raise or halt
items.why_now: The broad catch in _run_eval_gate can swallow exceptions, allowing partial results and violating fails-closed. This is a safety-critical flaw that must be fixed before any production use.

steps.do: Modify _run_eval_gate in picker.py to re-raise exceptions after logging, or set a flag to halt the main loop.
steps.verified_by: Write test_picker_handles_exception: mock correctness.py to raise Exception, verify that picker.py stops or re-raises.

items.assumption: The main loop in picker.py checks a return flag or exception to stop.

items.title: Validate OLLAMA_HOST is localhost or add explicit warning
items.why_now: warm_model makes HTTP requests to a configurable host; if set to remote, code violates no-egress requirement. This is a critical security design flaw.

steps.do: Add validation in warm_model.py that OLLAMA_HOST is 'localhost' or '127.0.0.1'; if not, raise an error or log a warning.
steps.verified_by: Write test_ollama_host_validation: set OLLAMA_HOST to remote, call warm_model, verify it raises ValueError or logs warning.

steps.do: Update documentation to warn against setting OLLAMA_HOST to remote address.

items.assumption: The requirement is strict no-egress; if remote is allowed, change to configurable option.

items.title: Add invariant check in _record_identity_anchor: recompute embedding and compare
items.why_now: The function claims to check an invariant but does not; if backend changes, anchors become stale. This is a high-severity data integrity issue.

steps.do: In _record_identity_anchor, after inserting anchor, recompute its embedding using current backend and compare with stored value; log warning if mismatch.
steps.verified_by: Write test_anchor_invariant_check: mock backend to return different embedding, verify warning is logged.

items.assumption: Recomputing embedding is feasible and not too expensive.

items.title: Trace identity verification propagation and ensure failure halts session
items.why_now: If verify_index_identity fails and the failure is not propagated, the embedding pipeline may silently produce bad data. This is a high-severity data integrity issue.

steps.do: Search for all calls to verify_index_identity across codebase; trace how return status is used.
steps.verified_by: Grep output showing all call sites.

steps.do: If any call site ignores failure, modify to propagate failure to session state (e.g., set session status to failed).
steps.verified_by: Write test_identity_verification_propagation: mock verify_index_identity to return False, verify session state is marked failed.

items.assumption: Session state is accessible and modifiable from call sites.

items.title: Update docstring in markdown.py to match actual implementation
items.why_now: Outdated docstring misleads developers. Low severity but easy to fix.

steps.do: Compare docstring claims with implementation in complete markdown.py file; update docstring to accurately describe behavior.

items.assumption: The full implementation is available to compare.

items.title: Fix scope-key mismatch in gated_writes.py: ensure resolver uses same scope as index
items.why_now: gated_writes.py may use a resolver built under a different scope than its index, causing data corruption. High severity.

steps.do: Trace scope_key usage in gated_writes.py; ensure resolution_context is called with the same scope_key as the index.
steps.verified_by: Write test_scope_key_match: create two scopes, write with mismatched keys, verify error or correct behavior.

items.assumption: The resolver can be built with a specific scope_key.

items.title: Verify cost computation uses tokens_B_true, not tokens_B
items.why_now: If cost metrics use truncated token count, cost calculations are inconsistent. Medium severity.

steps.do: Grep for 'tokens_B' in daedalus/eval/ and daedalus/mapping/ to identify which variable is used in cost computation.
steps.verified_by: Grep output shows usage of tokens_B_true.

steps.do: If tokens_B is used incorrectly, change to tokens_B_true.
steps.verified_by: Write test_cost_uses_tokens_B_true: mock data with different tokens_B and tokens_B_true, verify cost uses the true count.

items.assumption: tokens_B_true is available in the data passed to cost computation.

items.title: Document truncation in gui/lint.py Metric.to_dict
items.why_now: Docstring claims every metric returns count and elements, but to_dict truncates offenders to 12. Low severity but misleading.

steps.do: Update docstring of Metric.to_dict to mention truncation of offenders to 12.

items.assumption: The truncation limit is 12 as observed.
